channel.title: Destroyers Cricket Club News & Match Reports
channel.description: Official tournament dispatches, match reports, and announcements for Destroyers Cricket Club in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh.

item.title: 2026 Title Defence: Destroyers Hold Nerve 3–2 to Complete Championship Three-Peat
item.description: Destroyers defended their crown 3–2 in June 2026, sealing a third straight championship with a 12-run finale win at APSU Stadium.

item.title: Ajay Rohera's 94 (98) & 2 catches, 1 stumping drags Destroyers to 12-run win in 50 Overs derby
item.description: Destroyers won by 12 runs at APSU Stadium, Rewa — POTM Ajay Rohera (Destroyers): 94 (98) & 2 catches, 1 stumping.

item.title: Venkatesh Iyer's 115 (102 balls) steers Destroyers to 4-wicket win in 50 Overs derby
item.description: Destroyers won by 4 wickets at Martand School Ground No. 3, Rewa — POTM Venkatesh Iyer (Destroyers): 115 (102 balls).

item.title: Yash Dubey's 114 (108 balls) lifts Dread Eleven to 19-run win in 50 Overs derby
item.description: Dread Eleven won by 19 runs at APSU Stadium, Rewa — POTM Yash Dubey (Dread Eleven): 114 (108 balls).

item.title: Venkatesh Iyer's 82* (48 balls) fires Destroyers to 7-wicket win in T20 derby
item.description: Destroyers won by 7 wickets at Martand School Ground No. 3, Rewa — POTM Venkatesh Iyer (Destroyers): 82* (48 balls).

item.title: Yash Dubey's 92 (54 balls) carries Dread Eleven to 14-run win in T20 derby
item.description: Dread Eleven won by 14 runs at APSU Stadium, Rewa — POTM Yash Dubey (Dread Eleven): 92 (54 balls).

item.title: 2025 Invincible Sweep: Destroyers Whitewash Dread Eleven 5–0 in Perfect Season
item.description: Destroyers produced the first clean sweep in derby history in 2025, winning all five games across T20 and 50-over formats under skipper Pranav Dwivedi.

item.title: Venkatesh Iyer's 106 (92) & 2/36 (8 ov) powers Destroyers to 34-run win in 50 Overs derby
item.description: Destroyers won by 34 runs at APSU Stadium, Rewa — POTM Venkatesh Iyer (Destroyers): 106 (92) & 2/36 (8 ov).

item.title: Rajat Patidar's 108* (94 balls) drags Destroyers to 5-wicket win in 50 Overs derby
item.description: Destroyers won by 5 wickets at Martand School Ground No. 3, Rewa — POTM Rajat Patidar (Destroyers): 108* (94 balls).

item.title: Venkatesh Iyer's 124 (104) & 1/32 (8 ov) steers Destroyers to 45-run win in 50 Overs derby
item.description: Destroyers won by 45 runs at APSU Stadium, Rewa — POTM Venkatesh Iyer (Destroyers): 124 (104) & 1/32 (8 ov).
